notes: Noun meaning the ground or floor. It is most often seen in place phrases such as 地上.
Common motion verb meaning to cross or go past a place or obstacle, as in 过马路 cross the road.
Very common word for something good or nice. It can also mean to be fine or okay, and in some patterns it means to do something well.
Often means after in time expressions such as 下班后. It can also mean behind or the back of something.
This pronunciation, huan2, means to return something or give it back to someone.
Very common verb meaning open, turn on, or start. In other common expressions it can also mean drive or hold, as in 开车 and 开会.
Location word meaning inside or in the inside of a place.
Very common verb meaning to have something, or to say that something exists.

primary_gloss: be at; be in; at; in
notes: Often works as the main location verb meaning to be at or in a place. Before a place word, it also works like at, in, or on.
Most often an adverb meaning really or truly. As an adjective, it can also mean real or true.
Often used as an adverb meaning really. It can also describe something as true, genuine, or real.

primary_gloss: just; right in the middle of
notes: Before a verb, it often means an action is happening right then. It can also mean exactly.
